name: Hubei Huaqiang High-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Huaqiang High-Tech Co., Ltd. research, develops, produces, and sells pharmaceutical packaging, medical devices, and special protective equipment in China. It operates as a chemical defense military enterprise in special protection.
